description_en: Modifies the basic information about a database
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-database --instance-id bastionhost-cn-72137xe5n01 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-id 11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDatabase

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host that manages the database to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的数据库所在堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host that manages the database to modify.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的数据库所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database to modify
parameters.name: database_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the new network domain for the database.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html operation to query the network domain ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定修改后数据库所属的网络域的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
The new address type of the database. Valid values:

Public

Private
parameters.help_zh:
指定修改后的数据库地址类型。取值：
Public ：公网地址
Private ：私网地址
parameters.name: active_address_type

parameters.help_en: The new internal address of the database. Specify an IPv4 address or a domain name
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的数据库的私网地址。支持IPv4地址和域名格式
parameters.name: database_private_address

parameters.help_en: The new public address of the database. Specify an IPv4 address or a domain name
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的数据库的公网地址。支持IPv4地址和域名格式
parameters.name: database_public_address

parameters.help_en: The new port of the database
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的数据库端口
parameters.name: database_port

parameters.help_en: The new name of the database
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的数据库实例名称
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the ApsaraDB for RDS instance or PolarDB cluster to modify.

This parameter is required if Source is set to Rds or PolarDB
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的数据库实例ID。  
Source选择Rds或PolarDB时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: source_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The new remarks of the database
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的数据库备注信息
parameters.name: comment

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
